note: Regional park at the north end of Last Mountain Lake near Govan, inside the Last Mountain Lake bird sanctuary; level grass/gravel sites, portable toilets in the loops and a shower house, with a pool, sand-green golf course, beach and boat launch. The campground taps are non-potable; drinking water is at the concession. Cottage area beside the campground. --Claude
